name: Chunk-Based Voxel Terrain Generation
aliases: Voxel Terrain Generation via Chunked Noise Sampling
definition: A procedural terrain generation technique that divides the world into fixed-size 3D chunks (8x8x8 voxels) and generates voxel data per chunk using octaved noise functions, biome logic, and run-length encoding for storage.
summary: Chunk-Based Voxel Terrain Generation populates fixed-size cubic chunks with dense 3D voxel grids via noise sampling, enabling complex structures like caves and overhangs.
